AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
A Traumatic and Unsanitary Nightmare.
If I could give this place zero stars, I would. My recent stay here was not just disappointing; it was a traumatic ordeal that ended with my companions and me seeking refuge at a railway station in the middle of the night. Do not let the listing fool you; this place is a genuine health and safety hazard.
The Room: The photos speak for themselves, but let me be clear. The bedsheets were covered in large, disgusting stains and the pillows were visibly soiled and lumpy. The air conditioning unit was caked in a thick layer of grime. The overall state of the room was one of complete neglect and filth, making it absolutely uninhabitable.
The Bathroom: The bathroom was a disaster zone. The tap on the sink was so corroded and covered in buildup that it was practically crumbling. The shower fixtures were similarly rusted and dysfunctional. The entire space was dirty, with stained tiles and a general feeling of decay. Basic hygiene was simply not possible.
Our Ordeal: The conditions were so appalling that we immediately complained, but the staff were completely indifferent. For our own safety and well-being, we had no choice but to leave late at night—a humiliating and dangerous experience.
This establishment should not be allowed to operate. I am urging anyone reading this: DO NOT book a room here. You will be putting your health, safety, and money at risk. I am appalled that this property is even listed on booking platforms.
